Property.name: TuxedoService
Property.Description: Mode of communication to Tuxedo Service

Property.name: DrcUser
Property.Description: User to get the report date from CDR drc tables

Property.name: MaxRetryCount
Property.Description: how many times have we retried?

Property.name: InitStorage
Property.Description: Max Storage (in KiloBytes). Max that can allowcated to a process is 2147483647 KB. If you change this value, You meed to recycle the components.

Property.name: MinStorage
Property.Description: Min Storage (in KiloBytes). If the storage level reached less than 100KB, the process will run out of storage.

Property.name: WarnStorage
Property.Description: Warn Storage (in KiloBytes). The available storage is less. Very soon you may reach MINIMUM storage. If you change the value to -1, it will stop sending the warning alerts.

Method.name: OnInit
Method.Implementation:
do ##super() $$$TRACE("$$$$$ Inside OnInit() method...") #dim status as %Status set status = $$$OK $$$TRACE("IHC.ITF.Operation.OpCdrDsqlGetReportDate. OnInit.. Load JarFile "_ ..JarFiles) Set p=1
For { Set piece=$P(..JarFiles,":",p) Quit:piece="" set p = p+1 try { Set status= ..JavaGateway.%Import(piece) $$$TRACE("Jar file: " _ piece _ ", status: " _ status) } catch exp { $$$TRACE("Exception in jar file import: " _ exp) set errTxt = $System.Status.GetErrorText("Exception in jar file import: "_exp) set status=##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).DisableMsgError("OpCdrDsqlGetReportDate",errTxt) } } $$$TRACE("BaseOperation OnInit status: " _ status) return status

Method.name: OnMessage
Method.Implementation:
#dim status as %Status set status = $$$OK $$$TRACE("Inside OnMessage method<" _ pRequest.StringValue _ ">")
try{ $$$TRACE("Connect to " _ ..ApplicationAddress) $$$TRACE("Connect to " _ ..TuxedoService) set ..objCdrTuxService = ##class(org.ihc.itf.cdr.drc.CdrDrcLastRunReportDate).%New(..JavaGateway,..ApplicationAddress, ..TuxedoService, ..LogDirectory _"/" _$$$JobConfigName _".log", $$$ConfigTrace($$$JobConfigName)) set output = ..objCdrTuxService.GetLastReportDate(..DrcUser)
$$$TRACE("Output after invocation of GetLastReportDate Java Method<" _ output _ ">")
set pResponse = ##class(IHC.ITF.Response.OpCdrGetReportDate).%New() set pResponse.reportDate = output
$$$TRACE("Report Date (Response): <" _ output _ ">") }catch err{ $$$TRACE("Exception while getting LastReportDate thru Tuxedo Service: " _ err) set errTxt = $System.Status.GetErrorText("Exception while getting LastReportDate thru Tuxedo Service: "_err) set status=##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).RetryMsgError("OpCdrDsqlGetReportDate",errTxt) }
$$$TRACE("OnMessage(GetLastReportDate) status: " _ status)
return status
